weighting_note: Inside each bucket (static / reward_hacking / partial_oracle), each check has an integer weight: static checks are weight 1; reward_hacking checks are weight 1 or 2; partial_oracle checks are weight 1 or 3. The bucket's score is a weighted average of its checks: Sigma(weight x score) / Sigma(weight). The final reward is the fixed 1:2:3 static:reward_hacking:partial_oracle bucket blend, divided by 6. No per-check score uses a multiplier, exponent, or min()/max()-as-cap on top of this weighted-average structure -- every within-check blend (e.g. precision vs. recall, or a check's two required sub-sections) is a plain additive weighted sum.

static_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks a submission that never produced one or more required deliverables from reaching any content-scored check at all.

static_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Parses situation_register.csv, confirms the nine required columns (entry_id, source_file, document_type, date, issuing_body, topic_category, key_fact, supporting_quote, cross_document_link) are present, requires at least 130 rows, and requires every non-empty entry_id value to be unique across the register.
static_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents a malformed, wrong-shaped, or trivially thin register from being fed into the reward-hacking and partial-oracle checks as if it were a genuine attempt at the 40-file, 218k-word corpus. The entry_id uniqueness requirement additionally prevents a structural-integrity failure that content checks cannot see: cross_document_link resolution looks up the target row by entry_id, so a duplicate ID would silently make every link referencing it resolve to whichever row happens to appear last in the file, corrupting link verification regardless of how genuine either individual row is.

static_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores 0.5 for reconciliation_dossier.md having >=700 words, and 0.5 for reporting_audit.md having >=400 words AND both required section headings present (a heading line containing 'non-substantive' and one containing 'contradiction'). Deliberately does NOT judge quality, volume of citations, or truthfulness of either document -- purely a length/shape gate.
static_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops credit for a stub or placeholder narrative deliverable that could not possibly contain genuine realtime-vs-retrospective synthesis at the depth instruction.md asks for, before either is fed to the content-graded partial_oracle_checks_3/5.

reward_hacking_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For every register row whose source_file resolves to a real corpus file, the row counts toward this check's precision numerator only if it is 'eligible' per _prepare()'s shared gate: topic_category is one of the six defined values, supporting_quote is an exact (normalized) 8-60-word word-for-word substring of that file's real text, key_fact shares at least one distinctive content word (letters, lightly stemmed, or a standalone number/year) with its own verbatim quote, the row's declared document_type matches the real source_file's own top folder, and declared date is well-formed YYYY-MM-DD. precision = that eligible count / rows with a recognized source_file (purely mechanical, deterministic). Final score = (precision + realtime_coverage_recall) / 2, a plain arithmetic mean, where realtime_coverage_recall = distinct real REALTIME-stream files with >=1 quote-verified row / 29 real realtime files total -- deliberately scoped to only the 29-file realtime stream (the retrospective stream's coverage is a separate hard gate, reward_hacking_checks_3).
reward_hacking_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: This is the primary defense against the task's core fabrication risk: inventing a plausible-sounding fact and quote instead of citing real source text, so it carries weight 2 (the top of this bucket's 1/2 range) within its bucket. Because the SAME eligibility gate is used by every check below, a fabricated or mislabeled row does not just lose credit here -- it silently disappears from every other check's population too. A real observed execution of this task submitted a 511-row register with only 392 (77%) quote-verified; this check carries the maximum bucket weight so that fabrication rate is not diluted down by the five other, lower-weighted reward_hacking checks.

reward_hacking_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: precision = fraction of ALL register rows that are quote-verified (eligible) AND not an exact (source_file, supporting_quote) repeat of an earlier row (objective exact-match dedup, deterministic). Final score = (precision + realtime_coverage_recall) / 2, a plain arithmetic mean.
reward_hacking_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops inflating row count by repeating the identical (file, quote) pair to pad toward the 130-row floor. Its precision denominator is ALL rows, so it also implicitly penalizes rows with a fabricated source_file. The realtime_coverage_recall term stops a small, non-duplicated but corpus-narrow register from scoring as well as a genuinely broad one here.

reward_hacking_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: A hard per-file gate on the small, dense 11-file retrospective stream, DISTINCT from the blended-recall mechanism used for the 29-file realtime stream elsewhere in this verifier: for each of the 11 real retrospective files, counts whether the register has at least 2 quote-verified rows citing that exact file. score = covered files / 11. This value is NOT blended into any other check -- it stands alone as its own weighted check, unlike realtime_coverage_recall which is averaged into six other checks.
reward_hacking_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: The retrospective stream has only 11 files but is fact-dense (each file typically supports 6-9+ distinct rows), so a corpus-wide averaged recall term (appropriate for the 29-file realtime stream) would let an agent skip several retrospective files entirely while still posting a respectable blended average elsewhere. A hard per-file gate closes that: every one of the 11 real retrospective documents must show genuine, individually verifiable engagement, not just a subset of the richest ones.

reward_hacking_checks_4.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Samples EVERY source_file with >=1 quote-verified row, up to MAX_JUDGE_SAMPLE (200) files. For each, an LLM judge reads the full real document and the analyst's claimed rows, and reports two things: distinct_count (how many listed rows are genuinely distinct facts from each other) and missed_fact_count (how many ADDITIONAL genuinely distinct, reportable facts the real file contains that are NOT represented by any listed row). Per-file credit = max(0, distinct_count - missed_fact_count); precision = total credit / total rows listed across sampled files. Final score = (precision + realtime_coverage_recall) / 2, a plain arithmetic mean.
reward_hacking_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops three related padding/shortcut risks: (a) pulling two different quote spans from the same dense file that both describe the same underlying fact, banking two rows for one genuine fact (distinct_count); (b) shallow one-fact-per-file extraction that leaves real, distinct, reportable content un-logged in files that could have supported multiple rows -- an especially real risk in the 11 long, argument-dense retrospective files (missed_fact_count); and (c) cherry-picking a small number of fact-rich realtime files while leaving most of the 29-file stream untouched (realtime_coverage_recall). Weight raised from 1 to 2 (top of this bucket's 1/2 range) after a real observed execution of this task showed a 511-row register (~3x the corpus's own ~171-row human-effort estimate) where an LLM judge found only ~68% of sampled rows were genuinely distinct, non-padded facts -- padding-for-volume is a first-order reward-hacking risk this task's own MIN_ROWS floor invites, and this is the check built specifically to catch it, so it should not be one of the lowest-weighted checks in its bucket.

reward_hacking_checks_5.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Groups quote-verified rows by their real source_file and samples up to MAX_JUDGE_SAMPLE (200) source files; for each sampled file, an LLM judge is given the file's FULL real text and the analyst's claimed rows for it, and reports plausible_count -- how many rows pass ALL FOUR of: (a) key_fact is genuinely supported by supporting_quote (not invented/exaggerated), (b) topic_category is a reasonable, defensible fit (not merely a valid enum member -- that is already guaranteed by the eligibility gate), (c) supporting_quote is itself substantive real content, not boilerplate, (d) declared_date is accurate to the real reporting period/finding period the passage actually concerns. Conditions (c) and (d) are content-understanding questions judged by the LLM directly against the real surrounding text. precision = plausible_count / total listed. Final score = (precision + realtime_coverage_recall) / 2 -- a plain arithmetic mean, not a cap or multiplier.
reward_hacking_checks_5.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops four shortcuts no deterministic check can catch: (a) pairing a real, verbatim, on-topic-looking quote with an invented or exaggerated key_fact the quote doesn't actually support; (b) stuffing every row with a single fixed (but valid) category value without genuine per-row classification; (c) satisfying the round-trip and length checks with a real but content-free boilerplate line (a copyright notice, contact footer); (d) defaulting every row's date to a document's own publication date even when the cited passage clearly concerns a different real period.

reward_hacking_checks_6.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Three equally-weighted thirds, averaged. part_a: over ALL register rows, checks each row's cross_document_link is either NONE/empty or a real entry_id belonging to a row of the OPPOSITE document_type. part_b: restricted to quote-verified rows claiming a non-NONE link, the same well-formedness condition is re-checked (scores 0.0, not 1.0, if no row claims a link at all -- an all-NONE cross_document_link column does zero work on the task's hardest sub-task and must not score full credit on this signal too, mirroring check_partial_oracle_4's explicit 0.0-not-excluded treatment of the same condition; genuineness and minimum link VOLUME beyond this structural floor remain check_partial_oracle_4's separate concern). Both a and b are purely mechanical -- deterministic. part_c = realtime_coverage_recall: whether the register touched a representative slice of the 29-file realtime stream at all, independent of link count. Final score = (part_a + part_b + part_c) / 3, a plain arithmetic mean, not a cap or multiplier.
reward_hacking_checks_6.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: A cheap, deterministic floor that catches a cross_document_link column full of same-stream self-references, dangling entry_ids, or garbage values before the far more expensive LLM-judged partial_oracle_checks_4 is asked to evaluate whether any linked pair is genuinely the same underlying fact. Its link-count volume requirement deliberately lives in check_partial_oracle_4 instead, where it can be judged jointly with genuineness. Weight dropped from 2 to 1: structural well-formedness (a link either points at a real, opposite-stream entry_id or is NONE) is a near-trivial bar to clear and was scoring 0.94-1.0 even in a run whose actual linking effort (5 links total) was minimal -- this check should not carry equal weight to the checks that actually detect fabrication or padding.

partial_oracle_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For each of 46 hand-verified held-out facts in tests/reference_facts.json, spread across all 40 of the corpus's real files, an LLM judge reads that file's FULL real text and the analyst's rows claimed against that same source_file, and determines whether the fact is genuinely captured. Aggregated coverage = facts covered / usable facts.
partial_oracle_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: This is a core completeness measure the task exists to grade -- whether the register actually captures what these real documents say, not just a plausible-looking sample. Weighted 1 (the lower of this bucket's 1/3 tiers): in a real observed execution of this task this check was a genuinely strong, judge-verified signal (0.93) reflecting real extraction accuracy rather than a symptom of reward-hacking, so it does not need the bucket's top weight to still count meaningfully. The held-out facts are held out in tests/, not derivable from environment/. Spreading them across all 40 distinct real files (100% of the corpus) means no subset of the corpus can, on its own, saturate this check: genuine coverage requires genuinely reading the full 40-file corpus, across BOTH streams.

partial_oracle_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Samples up to MAX_JUDGE_SAMPLE (200) quote-verified rows in batches of 15; for each batch, an LLM judge is given the FULL real text of every file in the batch and the analyst's claimed issuing_body for each row, and reports which claimed issuing organizations are the genuinely correct real author/issuer of that file (masthead, byline, or publisher line). precision = judged-correct / judged. Final score = (precision + realtime_coverage_recall) / 2 -- a plain arithmetic mean, not a cap or multiplier. This is the SOLE attribution-correctness check in this verifier: determining who really issued a document is a content-understanding task, not a pattern match, so it is judged by the LLM directly rather than approximated by a deterministic heuristic.
partial_oracle_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Directly targets the specific single-agent failure mode task.toml's why_multi_agent names: assuming every file in a stream shares the same issuing organization when the real corpus deliberately does not (the realtime stream mixes WHO and UNICEF; the retrospective stream spans WHO, the UN, Oxfam, MSF, the UK House of Commons, and others). A row can pass reward_hacking_checks_1 (real quote) while still being wrong about WHICH real organization actually issued the file -- only a judge that reads the file's own masthead/byline can catch that. Weighted 1 (the lower of this bucket's 1/3 tiers), matching partial_oracle_checks_1: a real observed execution of this task scored genuinely well here (0.91), so this check's signal is a real capability measure rather than the kind of severe-failure detector (fabrication, near-total avoidance of the task's hardest sub-skill) that should carry this bucket's top weight.

partial_oracle_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Two equally-weighted signals, averaged. (1) LLM judge reads reconciliation_dossier.md ALONGSIDE up to 150 sampled quote-verified register rows and scores whether the dossier's claims are traceable to those rows, explicitly works through genuine realtime-vs-retrospective correspondence, and identifies how the real-time reporting's tone/framing shifted across the outbreak's emergency, decline, and flare-up/closure phases -- not just whether the prose reads well. The judge is also told the register's real realtime_coverage_recall figure and instructed to discount dossier claims of broad, corpus-wide synthesis that a register built from only a small fraction of the 29-file realtime stream cannot actually support, and is told that a dossier which never cites a specific entry_id from the register has not met instruction.md's explicit citation requirement. (2) A deterministic entry_id-citation-density signal: the dossier text is scanned for an explicit citation marker ("entry_id 12", "entry #12", "row R012" -- not a bare numeral, since this register's entry_id values are frequently plain integers that would otherwise collide with ordinary case-count prose) whose captured token resolves to a real entry_id in the register; density = min(1.0, distinct_real_entry_ids_cited / 8). Final score = (judge_score + citation_density) / 2, a plain arithmetic mean, not a cap or multiplier.
partial_oracle_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops credit for a fluent, plausible-sounding dossier that names real dates and organizations but invents its actual causal claims, never actually connects what the two streams each say about the same periods, or asserts specific quantitative claims about the register (e.g. a false count of confirmed cross-document links) that do not hold up against the register's own data -- the judge is given the verified register as the only legitimate evidence base. The deterministic citation-density signal closes a gap the judge alone cannot reliably enforce: instruction.md explicitly requires the dossier to 'point to specific entry_ids... to back every claim', and a dossier that is fluent, accurate-sounding, and even genuinely well-organized but never once names a specific entry_id has not met that requirement regardless of how favorably an LLM judge might read its prose. Weighted 3 to match its sibling partial_oracle checks, consistent with instruction.md's explicit framing of this deliverable as 'the work no single stream can do on its own.'

partial_oracle_checks_4.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Samples up to MAX_JUDGE_SAMPLE (200) quote-verified rows with a non-NONE cross_document_link; for each, an LLM judge is given the FULL real text of both the row's own source_file and its linked counterpart's source_file, plus both rows' claimed content, and determines genuinely_linked -- whether the two rows really document the same underlying real-world period and claim. If no row claims a non-NONE link, this check scores 0.0 (NOT excluded from its bucket's average). Otherwise, score = (precision + recall) / 2, where precision = genuine/judged among the sampled claimed links, and recall = min(1.0, genuine_count / _min_cross_document_links(ctx)). _min_cross_document_links(ctx) = max(15, round(total_real_files * 0.5)) -- 20 for this 40-file corpus, tracking task.toml's own human_solving_hours_justification estimate of ~25 genuine reconciliation threads (raised from the previous max(6, ceil(total_files/6))=7 floor, which let a real observed execution of this task with only 5 total links -- roughly 1% of its 511 rows -- claim 0.71 recall). Critically, recall is computed from the GENUINE count only, never the raw claimed or structurally-well-formed count.
partial_oracle_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: This is the authoritative signal for the task's signature difficulty AND the sole owner of the cross_document_link coverage/volume requirement. A naive agent can produce structurally-valid links by pairing rows on general topic proximity alone -- this corpus specifically contains retrospective claims about capacity, risk, or case trends that are not tied to whichever nearby real-time report happens to also mention the same general topic, making naive topic-based linking systematically wrong on several real cases. Because recall is computed from the genuine count, fabricating structurally-valid-but-fake links can never raise this check's score: an all-NONE register and a register with exactly _min_cross_document_links(ctx) fabricated links score identically here (both 0.0). The raised recall floor now also stops a register that finds a handful of genuine links but otherwise skips the task's own explicitly-hardest sub-skill (see why_multi_agent) from scoring near-full marks on this signal.

partial_oracle_checks_5.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Parses reporting_audit.md into its two required sections. For the Non-Substantive Passages section, an LLM judge is given up to 8 sampled cited real files' full text plus the analyst's own justification text, and reports how many cited cases are BOTH genuinely non-substantive AND truthfully justified (precision), blended 50/50 with a recall component = min(1.0, judged-GENUINE citation count / 5) -- recall is computed from the same judged-good count as precision, not from the raw unjudged citation count. For the Contradictions section, an LLM judge is given up to 10 cited files (spanning both streams), the analyst's own explanatory text, AND reconciliation_dossier.md's own text, and reports how many citations are part of a genuinely grounded explanation of a real realtime-vs-retrospective contradiction that is ALSO distinct from whatever the dossier already narrated -- instruction.md explicitly requires this section be distinct from the dossier's own narrative; this half likewise blends a recall component (judged-genuine citation pairs against a >=3-pair floor, not a raw citation count) with judged precision. The check's final score is (non_substantive_score + contradictions_score) / 2, a plain arithmetic mean.
partial_oracle_checks_5.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Targets the exact failure mode a scripted keyword-filter pipeline cannot fake: distinguishing genuine boilerplate from substantive reporting requires reading and understanding what a passage actually says, and finding genuine realtime-vs-retrospective contradictions requires comparative reading across two entire real documents from different streams, not a shared-keyword match. Passing reconciliation_dossier.md's own text into the contradictions judge call enforces instruction.md's 'distinct from the dossier' requirement directly: without it, an agent could repeat the dossier's own contradiction pairs in the audit with zero penalty. Weighted 3 (top of this bucket's 1/3 range): a real observed execution of this task scored a genuine 1.0 on the Non-Substantive half but 0.0 on the Contradictions half (0/4 sampled citations judged genuinely grounded -- the entire required section was fabricated), landing this check at 0.5 overall; that severity should count fully in its bucket rather than be given the same low weight as a check that mostly reflects baseline extraction accuracy.
